# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- During calibration, normalize stored measurements to consistent units (°C and %RH). Serial numbers are stable identifiers. For calibration records, store both foreign keys to current entities and snapshots of entity data at start/end.
- Calibration sampling: never sample during ramp or soak; only sample after the chamber is stable and soak has completed (or user skipped). Sample interval is 15 seconds to allow background updates/ASIC update.
